# First, identify the last two competitions based on the year column
# Sort by year descending to get the most recent competitions
sorted_df = df.sort_values('year', ascending=False)

# Get the last two competitions (two most recent years)
last_two = sorted_df.head(2)

# Extract the notes column which contains the distance as a string with " m"
# Convert to numeric by removing the " m" and converting to float
distances = last_two['notes'].str.replace(' m', '').astype(float)

# Calculate the average of these distances
average_distance = distances.mean()

# Check if the average is equal to 78.27 (using a small tolerance for floating point comparison)
answer = abs(average_distance - 78.27) < 1e-9
